scholarships.name: Registration Fee Discount
scholarships.description: Available in select terms, this discount reduces the initial registration cost, making it easier to secure a place in a program.

scholarships.name: Academic Scholarship
scholarships.description: Awarded to students with a strong academic background, this scholarship recognises consistent performance and commitment to learning.

scholarships.name: Creative Portfolio Scholarship
scholarships.description: Designed for applicants who demonstrate originality, skill, and creative thinking through their portfolio.

scholarships.name: International Student Grant
scholarships.description: Created to support students joining from outside the country, this grant helps ease the transition into studying abroad.

scholarships.name: Sibling Discount
scholarships.description: Offered to families with more than one sibling enrolled, providing fee support across multiple enrolments.

scholarships.name: Alumni Discount
scholarships.description: Available to returning students who have previously studied at SAE, supporting continued education and professional growth.

scholarships.name: Essad Card Discount
scholarships.description: A special benefit for Essad Card holders, offering additional savings on selected programs and fees.
